purpose: Define a reproducible frozen-feature probe for later research only.
adoption: This is not an adopted model, conditioning method, training plan, inference path, or evaluator change.

upstream.source_download: git clone https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2.git dinov2 && git -C dinov2 checkout --detach 7764ea0f912e53c92e82eb78a2a1631e92725fc8
upstream.source_api: hubconf.py exports dinov2_vits14; dinov2/hub/backbones.py accepts pretrained=False and a local weights path; the ViT implementation exposes get_intermediate_layers and normalized x_norm_patchtokens.
upstream.checkpoint: dinov2_vits14_pretrain.pth from the general LVD-142M model release only
upstream.checkpoint_hash_provenance: Measured 2026-10-12 by streaming the complete primary published URL response through shasum -a 256; 88,283,115 response bytes. This is a locally computed SHA-256, not an upstream-published digest.

checkpoint_http_metadata_observed.metadata_note: ETag is multipart and is not treated as a cryptographic checksum.

feature_contract.input: uint8 RGB image in HWC layout, at native pixel dimensions
feature_contract.padding: Pad bottom and right with RGB white (255,255,255) to the next multiple of 14; never resample.
feature_contract.model: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14, eval mode, local source checkout, explicit local checkpoint, no implicit download, extraction under no_grad.

output.geometry: The output grid must equal the padded image height and width divided by 14.
output.valid_patch_mask: A patch is valid when its top-left corner is inside the native image. With ceil-to-14 padding this currently marks every output patch valid because the grid has no wholly padded patches; the mask makes the native-vs-padded rule explicit but does not remove edge patches.
output.edge_patch_assumption: Partially padded edge patches contain white padding and are pooled with equal weight to fully native patches. This is a probe baseline, not an established optimum.

feature_contract.query_baseline: Mean the finite 384-dimensional features of valid query patches.

future_pair_classifier_proposal.conditioning: For each candidate drawing tile, use the mean valid-patch query embedding and the tile's spatial patch features. A later classifier may compare the query vector to each spatial feature and predict a match map.
future_pair_classifier_proposal.fit_scope: Fit any projection, normalization, classifier weights, or decision threshold using only the designated training split. Do not fit on validation or test labels.
future_pair_classifier_proposal.validation_scope: Use validation labels only for model selection and threshold selection under a separately recorded protocol.
future_pair_classifier_proposal.test_scope: Keep test labels unavailable to feature design, fitting, and threshold selection.

smallest_numerical_smoke_proposal.input: Exactly two synthetic uint8 RGB images at native size, 15x29x3 and 896x896x3; no dataset or labels and no resampling.
smallest_numerical_smoke_proposal.expected_geometry: The 15x29 image white-pads to 28x42 and yields 2x3x384 features; the native 896x896 image yields 64x64x384 features. Both patch masks are all true and each query embedding has width 384.
smallest_numerical_smoke_proposal.resource_feasibility: The 896x896 image is included to measure the 4,096-token ViT-S/14 forward memory requirement. Runtime and memory are unmeasured until the root-owned smoke runs.
checks: All feature and query embedding values are finite.
Model reports eval mode and every parameter has requires_grad=false.
The 15x29 output has 6 tokens and the 896x896 output has 4,096 tokens; each output width is 384.
Record actual output dimensions, device, timings, and memory; do not assert a speed or memory target before measuring.
smallest_numerical_smoke_proposal.resource_method: Run once in a fresh process, sequentially on CPU unless the root selects another device; capture resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss and normalize units for the OS. This process high-water mark may not capture all macOS Metal/MPS unified-memory allocations or system-wide pressure, so retain the root run's /usr/bin/time -l output and inspect peak footprint and swap fields. Keep the run to one model instance and exactly two images.
smallest_numerical_smoke_proposal.measurement_status: All load/forward timings and resource measurements remain unmeasured until the root-owned run.

numerical_model_smoke_test: Deferred to root-owned numerical queue; this author performed metadata-only source verification and streamed the published checkpoint only to calculate its checksum, without saving a local weights file or running inference.
